BL-685 — Detect a mono-router resident stranded off its home role — the turn-boundary failure both existing safeguards miss by construction
What it solves: Specced 2026-07-27 from the operator intake, which is now archived.
Approval context: The intake was explicit that it is "a report, not a design" and asked the specifier to size it. Sizing it produced one real choice, which is what needs sign-off:
This ticket specs DETECTION only — the deterministic sweep grows a check that sees a stranded resident and nudges the coordinator, which …
BL-685 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-685" (or "reject BL-685 <reason>") to act.
